grammar_focus: 复习 KS13/37/61 将来的各种时态(收官包·干净课照搬美语化):一般将来时 will do、将来进行时 will be doing、将来完成时 will have done、将来完成进行时 will have been doing 的构成与辨析,以及 by/in/at this time 等时间标志的搭配
scene: 下个月,我七十岁的爷爷就要上大学了。到明年这个时候,他就读完一年级了。“到我下个生日,我就整整学满一年了,”他自豪地说。开学那天,大家都会关注他表现如何。“有些人会笑话我,”他坦言,“但我不介意。五年后,我就能拿到学位了。”他会和比自己小六十岁的同学坐在同一间教室里。“学新东西,永远不嫌老,”他对我说。等他毕业时,他会证明所有人都想错了。我觉得,他会成为这所大学有史以来最鼓舞人心的学生。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS13/37/61 将来的各种时态
grammar_card.intro: 本课把“将来”的四种时态放在一起复习:①一般将来 will do——单纯说将来会怎样(Some people will laugh);②将来进行 will be doing——将来某个时刻正在进行(This time tomorrow, he will be sitting in class);③将来完成 will have done——到将来某个时间点之前已经完成(By next year, he will have finished his first year);④将来完成进行 will have been doing——到将来某时为止一直持续(By my next birthday, I will have been studying for a year)。看时间标志选形式:by + 时间点 常配将来完成,at/this time + 时间点 常配将来进行,in + 一段时间 表“……之后”。

rows: Some people will laugh, but he doesn't mind.
将来进行 will be doing
This time tomorrow, he will be sitting in class.
将来完成 will have done
By next year, he will have finished his first year.
将来完成进行 will have been doing
By his birthday, he will have been studying for a year.

specialRules.rule: 美语“成绩、分数”说 grade(英式 mark);“数学”说 math(英式 maths)。本课已按美语写。
by + 时间点 → 将来完成(之前完成);at/this time + 时间点 → 将来进行(那一刻正在做);in + 一段时间 → “……之后”。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is the grandfather going to do next month?

passage: Next month, my grandfather will be starting college at the age of seventy. By this time next year, he will have finished his first year. "By my next birthday, I will have been studying for a whole year," he says proudly. On the first day, everyone will be watching to see how he does. "Some people will laugh," he admits, "but I don't mind. In five years, I will have earned my degree." He will be sitting in class with students sixty years younger. "You will never be too old to learn something new," he tells me. By the time he graduates, he will have proved everyone wrong. I think he will be the most inspiring student the college has ever seen.
